name: Quantum Circuit Simulator
description: Simulate small quantum circuits (up to 8 qubits) supplied as a simple gate list; reports measurement counts, success probability, and an ASCII circuit diagram.

inputs.label: Gate list
inputs.description: One gate per line. Supported: H q, X q, Y q, Z q, S q, T q, CX q1 q2, CZ q1 q2, SWAP q1 q2, RX q theta, RY q theta, RZ q theta. Qubits are 0-indexed. Lines starting with # are comments. First non-comment line may be 'qubits N' to set width (default 3).

inputs.label: Success state
inputs.description: Bitstring (most-significant qubit first) treated as 'success'. Leave blank to skip success-probability output.
